meta.title: PintoPets
meta.description: A friendly home for pet owners: keep your pets' records in one place, ask everyday questions and talk to other owners.

home.heading: What's worrying you about your pet?
home.intro: Ask in your own words. We'll check for urgent signs first, then explain common reasons and when to see a vet.
home.label: Describe what's happening
home.placeholder: For example: Why is my 8 month old dog sick straight after eating?
home.disclaimer: PintoPets gives general information, not a diagnosis. Only a vet can diagnose and treat your pet.
home.urgentTitle: If your pet seems very unwell right now
home.urgentBody: Trouble breathing, collapse, heavy bleeding, a swollen belly with retching, or anything they may have swallowed or eaten that could be poisonous: contact a vet now.
home.featuresHeading: Everything for your pets, in one place
home.featurePetsBody: Profiles, photos, health records, diet and microchip details for every pet you care for.
home.featureAskBody: Plain-English answers based on articles reviewed by vets and vet nurses.
home.featureCommunityBody: Talk to other owners about the same worries, with answers from verified vet professionals.

ask.title: Ask AI
ask.comingTitle: The pet assistant is on its way
ask.comingBody: Soon you'll get an answer here, starting with a check for urgent signs. For now, if you're worried, please contact your vet.

placeholder.pets: Add your pets and keep their profiles, photos, health records and microchip details together.
placeholder.community: Forums for every kind of pet, with answers from verified vets and vet nurses.
placeholder.reminders: Vaccinations, flea and worm treatments, medicines and document expiry dates, all in one list.
placeholder.account: Sign-in, security (including authenticator app codes) and your plan will live here.

notFound.title: We couldn't find that page
notFound.body: It may have moved, or the link may be wrong.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: Sorry, that didn't work. Please try again. If your pet needs help urgently, contact a vet.

footer.notVetAdvice: Information on PintoPets is not a replacement for advice from your vet.
